=== chunk 0 | Widget Specification | location 1 | 48 tokens ===
--- context ---
Widget Specification
--- text ---
The WX-2048 widget is a modular sorter rated for 1200 items per minute. Operating temperature: -10 to 55 degrees Celsius. Power draw: 48 W nominal, 65 W peak during calibration.

=== chunk 1 | Electrical Interface | location 2 | 49 tokens ===
--- context ---
Widget Specification
Electrical Interface
--- text ---
The widget connects over a 24 V DC bus with an M12 A-coded connector. Pin 1 carries power, pin 3 is ground, pins 2 and 4 carry RS-485 data.
